intro: The rentals pack, for equipment, party, car and tool hire: what you hire out, each agreement from hand-out to return, and what is due back. Switch it on in Settings › Industry packs for the places that hire things out.
start: Switch the rentals pack on in Settings › Industry packs, for the places that hire things out.
Add each item you hire out on Items, with its rate and deposit, then add its units with their tag codes.
Reserve your first rental on Agreements, and hand it out when the customer collects it.
Check Returns due each day for what is late and what is due back.

articles.title: Add something to hire out
articles.summary: An item is what you hire out, with its rate and deposit. Its units are the real pieces, each with a tag you scan at hand-out and return.

steps.lead: Give it a name and rate,
steps.rest: charged per day or per hour, and the deposit for each unit. Add its own late rate if it has one.

steps.lead: Enter the new unit's tag code
steps.rest: and press Add the unit, once for each piece you own.
to check how many units are free for a period: enter from, back by and how many, and press Ask.

tips: A unit that needs mending can be taken off for mending, so nobody hires it. Press Put back when it is fixed.
Without its own late rate, an item's late fee follows your rentals settings.

articles.title: Reserve and hand out a rental
articles.summary: Reserve the units for the customer's dates, then hand them out with each tag scanned, the customer's signature and the deposit.

steps.lead: Choose the customer, the item and how many,
steps.rest: with From and Due back, and who brings it back: the customer or your collector. Press Reserve.
on the rental when the customer collects it.
with a reference, and press Hand out.

tips: A unit is never held by two rentals at once.
Press Extend to give a new due time, with the reason.

articles.title: Take a rental back and settle it
articles.summary: Scan each unit back, note any damage, then settle: rent, late fees and damage become one invoice, and the deposit pays them first.

steps.lead: Find the rental on Returns due
steps.rest: and press Check in. The rental opens.
A drawer lists each unit on the rental.

steps.lead: Tick each unit as its tag is scanned,

steps.rest: and say what the damage comes to. The unit leaves the calendar until it is mended.
A late fee is charged for the time past due.

steps.lead: Confirm or waive each damage charge

steps.rest: say where the rest of the deposit went, and press Settle the rental.

tips: Until the item is back, Returns due shows the late fee so far as an estimate.
A rental cannot be settled while a damage charge is still undecided.
